result.title: CASE: Confusion-Aware Skill Evolution for Frozen Multimodal Emotion Models
result.summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have substantially advanced Multimodal Emotion Recognition (MER) by enabling fine-grained emotion understanding through reasoning over multimodal evidence. However, they still exhibit systematic confusion between semantically adjacent emotions with highly overlapping multimodal cues. Existing approaches typically address these errors through global parameter adaptation, making confusion correction costly and inflexible. We instead observe that emotion confusion is highly localized and therefore better addressed through reusable pair-specific expertise. Building on this insight, we propose Confusion-Aware Skill Evolution (CASE), the first agent-skill framework for MER. CASE maintains a sparse, self-evolving library of pair-specific EmotionSkills that externalize affective expertise from model parameters, enabling the learned expertise to be continuously refined and readily transferred across diverse frozen MLLM backbones. During inference, CASE dynamically retrieves the appropriate EmotionSkill to reinforce boundary-aware reasoning while keeping the MLLM backbone frozen. Extensive experiments on CA-MER, DFEW, and EMER demonstrate the effectiveness and transferability of CASE across both general-purpose and emotion-specialized MLLMs. Notably, CASE improves the average accuracy of Qwen3-VL-8B on the CA-MER benchmark from 46.80% to 59.13%, while achieving consistent gains across MLLMs.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 CASE：针对语义相近、多模态线索重叠的易混淆情绪，维护一个稀疏、自演化的成对 EmotionSkill 技能库，在冻结 MLLM 主干的前提下于推理时检索对应技能以强化边界推理，并在 CA-MER、DFEW、EMER 上验证效果与跨主干迁移性。
AI.relevance_reason: 该文把易混淆情形的知识外化为可检索、可演化的技能而非改动参数，可能为 LVR 中按混淆/不确定度触发的外部证据检索与技能路由提供类比；但它不涉及内部 latent 状态、视觉表示或推理轨迹，与主线的实际联系较远，可供核查。
